target:
def Target : Prop :=
  ∀ (Fm S : Type) [LogicalConnective Fm] [LogicalNeutral Fm] [Entailment S Fm] (𝓢 : S) [Entailment.Cl 𝓢]
    (T K : Fm → Fm) (σ S₀ S' G P Q : Fm),
    𝓢 ⊢ σ 🡒 T σ → Def3 𝓢 K →
    𝓢 ⊢ σ 🡒 S₀ →
    𝓢 ⊢ S₀ 🡒 T σ 🡒 S' →
    𝓢 ⊢ S' 🡒 G →
    𝓢 ⊢ S' 🡒 ∼P →
    𝓢 ⊢ Q 🡒 P →
    𝓢 ⊢ σ 🡒 K (σ 🡒 G) 🡒 Q →
    𝓢 ⊢ ∼σ

divergences.description: Arithmetic, Gödel coding, quantifiers, and the internal structure of formal systems F_e, F_e+, the Gödel sentence G(F_e+), and the type-free predicates T and K are not modelled: the six statements of Penrose's argument are abstracted to opaque sentence parameters (σ, S₀, S', G, P, Q), T and K are arbitrary functions Fm → Fm, and the quantification over an arbitrary natural number e is not represented explicitly. (Declared as a limitation in the claim.)

The principle (K → T) stated at the outset of the source passage is omitted, and the metamathematical and predicate-logic justifications of steps (1), (2), (3), (4), (6), and (7)—including reflection, the nature of the Gödel sentence, Gödel's incompleteness theorem, properties of provability in F_e vs. F_e+, and extensionality of K = F_e—are not derived but instead enter as six black-box propositional bridging hypotheses. Consequently, the formal statement only verifies the propositional-plus-necessitation skeleton connecting those hypotheses. (Declared in the claim.)

The principle (T-In) is stated in the source passage as the general schema φ → T(φ), whereas the TARGET assumes only the single instance 𝓢 ⊢ σ 🡒 T σ (and places no other constraint on T). Since this weakens a hypothesis, it is a harmless strengthening of the theorem reflecting that (T-In) is only applied at σ in the argument.

judgement.summary: Within its declared abstract propositional setting, the TARGET accurately formalizes the logical skeleton of Koellner's eight-step Penrose argument, capturing the object-level use of T-In at σ, the meta-level rule K-Intro, and all six bridging implications in the right direction to derive ∼σ. Its divergences from the source passage are the explicitly declared idealizations—abstracting away arithmetic, coding, quantifiers, (K → T), and the metamathematical justifications of the bridging steps—plus a harmless strengthening that assumes T-In only at σ.
